description: Experience the rich, bold flavor of a true Classic Italian Espresso, a cornerstone of Italian culture and daily life. This concentrated coffee beverage, topped with a beautiful golden crema, offers an intense aromatic journey with every sip. It's the perfect way to invigorate your senses and enjoy a moment of authentic Italian tradition.

instructions.title: Prepare Your Equipment
instructions.text: Ensure your espresso machine and grinder are clean and preheated. Warm your demitasse cups by placing them on top of the machine or rinsing with hot water. This prevents the espresso from cooling too quickly.

instructions.title: Grind the Coffee Beans
instructions.text: Measure out 18-20 grams of fresh espresso beans for a double shot. Grind them immediately before brewing to a fine consistency, similar to powdered sugar but not clumpy. The grind size is critical for proper extraction.

instructions.title: Dose and Tamp the Portafilter
instructions.text: Distribute the ground coffee evenly in the portafilter basket. Use a tamper to apply firm, even pressure (around 30 lbs) to create a level, compact puck. A consistent tamp is essential for even water flow and extraction.

instructions.title: Purge the Group Head
instructions.text: Before inserting the portafilter, briefly run the espresso machine's group head to clear any old coffee grounds and ensure the water temperature is stable. This also helps to clean the screen.

instructions.title: Brew the Espresso
instructions.text: Insert the portafilter into the group head and immediately start the brew cycle. The espresso should begin to flow after 5-8 seconds, appearing as a steady, honey-like stream. Aim for an extraction time of 25-30 seconds for a double shot, yielding approximately 60 ml of espresso.

instructions.title: Serve Immediately
instructions.text: Once the desired volume is reached, stop the brew cycle. Remove the portafilter and discard the used coffee puck. Serve the freshly brewed espresso in your pre-warmed demitasse cups, enjoying the rich crema and intense aroma right away.

tips: Always use freshly roasted, high-quality espresso beans for the best flavor and crema. Beans should be used within a few weeks of roasting.
The grind size is crucial; it should be fine enough to offer resistance but not so fine as to choke the machine. Adjust as needed based on your beans and machine.
Serve espresso immediately in pre-warmed demitasse cups to maintain temperature and preserve the delicate crema. A cold cup can ruin the experience.
